# The Newer Dark Ages: Cast Bible

Generated from the site data and [ART-DIRECTION.md](ART-DIRECTION.md). 147 characters across 8 peoples. Also available as a spreadsheet: **CAST.xlsx** (same data, one row per character) and **CAST.json**.

**Gender split:** Male 70, Female 60, Nonbinary 17. **Combat/support:** 120/27. **With final art:** 86.

## Art direction in one screen

**Core principle: design for silhouette first, character second, detail last.** Samurai Jack flat geometry + Sin City heavy blacks + 1980s glam-gothic + salvaged retro-cyberpunk + classic fantasy.

- **Required:** strong, recognizable full-body silhouette; flat geometric color shapes; angular construction and deliberate exaggeration; clean, minimal contour lines; heavy, solid black shapes; stark white highlights; maximum two tonal planes per material; clear separation between overlapping forms; readable anatomy and gestures; stylized, expressive face; strong negative space around arms, legs, weapons and accessories; consistent visual weight with the rest of the roster.
- **Forbidden:** photorealism; 3D rendering or CGI; painterly brushwork; watercolor or oil-paint texture; anime-style fine detail; soft airbrushing; gradients; bloom, lens flare or realistic glow (any glow is a flat solid shape); detailed fabric textures; excessive tiny costume decorations; individual hairs or fur strands; realistic material reflections; generic fantasy concept-art rendering.
- **Colors:** exactly three accents per character: main about 60%, secondary about 30%, pop about 10%, plus black, white and grey. Exact hex, flat fills. The People background color is never a character color.
- **The Samurai Jack check (every portrait must pass all five):** (1) Would the silhouette remain recognizable if filled entirely with black? (2) Could the character be animated using relatively few large shapes? (3) Is the design readable at thumbnail size? (4) Are the colors flat and intentionally separated? (5) Is the character distinctive without relying on elaborate surface details?

## How to use the prompts

- Characters: gpt-image-1.5, 1024x1536, transparent PNG. Backgrounds: gpt-image-2, 1536x1024. `node tools/generate-character.mjs <id>` does both, attaches the approved characters as style references, self-vets every attempt and retries.
- Each prompt is self-contained and under 4000 characters. Hierarchy: People › Class › Subclass.


---

# Human
*People color: Gold #d9a521. Background setting: a barricaded highway-overpass settlement: stacked shipping containers, riveted gates, a tall radio mast, sodium street lamps, rain-slick asphalt, tarp banners.*

**Tagline:** No fangs, no fur. Just chrome, nerve and a very loud stereo.  
**Classes:** Roadwar Convoys (Interceptors, Outriders, Fuel Zealots); Arcade Clans (Joystick Duelists, Pinball Gunners, Token Brokers); Pirate Radio (Static Jammers, Skyline DJs, Late-Night Hosts); Mall Republic (Riot Marshals, Escalator Lancers, Concierge Diplomats); Summoners (Ninja Shoguns)

**Samurai Jack check (targets for this character)**

1. Black-fill test: the silhouette must still read as wide fighting stance with the crowbar swung back over one shoulder.
2. Few large shapes: heavy trapezoids, oversized fists and shoulders; no more than about a dozen major shapes (head, torso, limbs, main garment, signature gear).

5. Distinctive without detail: identifiable by Armored coupe and ram-bar and the bruiser shape language.

**Character prompt**

```text
An original character model sheet for a flat-color 2D animated series: extremely simple large flat shapes, one thin uniform black outline, flat solid colors, minimal detail, angular geometric construction, heavy solid black shapes and a few stark white highlights, like a hand-drawn paper cutout. It must look like a clean animation cel, NOT detailed illustration or fantasy concept art.
CHARACTER: Interceptors, male human (Irish-Scottish heritage, Scottish), apparent age mid 40s. wiry and hard-jawed, medium size. Pose: wide fighting stance with the crowbar swung back over one shoulder. Expression: fierce, jaw set, one eyebrow cocked, as a minimal face. Design the silhouette first (heavy trapezoids, oversized fists and shoulders); the pose and the hero prop must read as a solid black shape.
SIMPLIFICATION BUDGET (the most important rule): HERO PROP, the one detailed object: ram-bar. SECOND ITEM, kept plain: tire-iron. COSTUME: only three big masses (main garment, legs, boots) as large flat angular polygons. Source costume notes, to be CUT by about 70% and used only as a loose guide: hard-jawed human driver in a spiked black leather jacket, driving gloves, goggles pushed up on the forehead and boots, one hand gripping a heavy tire-iron, the other fist wrapped in a spiked knuckle-duster.

HOW TO DRAW IT: FIGURE: about 12 to 15 big shapes in total; OUTLINE: one thin, uniform-weight black line; SHADING: each material is one flat color plus at most one flat darker shadow shape; no shine or soft shading; FACE: minimal; simple geometric eye shapes under one brow line, one nose line, one mouth line; no eyelashes, eye highlights or skin shading; HAIR and FUR: two to four big solid pointed shapes, never strands, braids, curls or texture; FABRIC: large flat planes with straight or sharply angled edges and at most three big creases; no ragged hems, streamers, patterns, trim bands, tassels, stitching, studs or rows of buckles; METAL and GEAR: plain solid shapes in flat grey, black or an assigned color; no engraving; HANDS and FEET: simple blocky shapes; at most ONE repeated graphic symbol on the whole figure; clear negative space between limbs, prop and body.
COLOR (exact hex, flat fills): main #d00000 about 60%, on the largest garment, armor, fur-marking or body areas; secondary #f8f9fa about 30%, on trim, sash, straps, secondary garment pieces and held gear; pop #ffba08 about 10%, on the eyes, the Armored coupe and one small magical detail. Also allowed: black, white, neutral grey and one flat simplified skin, fur or species tone. No cream, tan, brass, gold or silver unless assigned. Never use #d9a521 (background only).
NEVER: photorealism, 3D or CGI, painterly or watercolor texture, airbrushing, gradients, glow or bloom (a glow is a flat solid shape), fabric texture, tiny decorations, individual hairs, realistic reflections, generic fantasy concept art.
SELF-CHECK: it must still read when filled solid black, be buildable from a few large shapes, read at thumbnail size, use flat separated colors and stay distinctive without surface detail; if not, remove detail.
COMPOSITION: one full-body figure, head to toe, nothing cropped, clear margin, centered, all shapes fully filled and opaque. True transparent background: no floor, shadow, scene, checkerboard, border or text. 3:4 portrait. Bruiser, combat, Human people, mature dark-age tone, no nudity, no gore.
```

**Background prompt**

```text
Heavily stippled charcoal and ink illustration on toned paper, a high-contrast black-and-white graphic-novel panel: dense dotted halftone and grainy ink texture over every surface, bold black ink linework, hand-drawn painted shapes. NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT smooth digital concept art, no lens flare. 16:9 landscape, 1980s post-apocalyptic neo-retro cyberpunk dark-age mood.
SCENE: a barricaded highway-overpass settlement: stacked shipping containers, riveted gates, a tall radio mast, sodium street lamps, rain-slick asphalt, tarp banners. An empty environment for Interceptors with no people, creatures, figures, silhouettes or text. Midground: an armored coupe with a spiked ram-bar and one glowing amber headlight parked at the lower-right, stacks of spare tires. Foreground: a fuel drum, a hand-painted convoy banner, plus wet ground reflecting light. Large props the character cannot wear or carry live here, never in a hand.
COLOR (most important): a GOLD-washed painting. The people color #d9a521 washes about 65% of the image across sky, fog, ground, walls and haze. Accents about 20%, clearly visible: main #d00000 for the biggest glowing sources and surfaces, secondary #f8f9fa for medium panels, banners and lights, pop #ffba08 for small sparks and glints, reflected on the ground. Black and white for ink linework, deep shadows and highlights.
COMPOSITION: horizon at one-third height, a moon upper-left, open empty space in the lower center where the character will stand, props pushed to the left and right edges.
```
